name: Substance-Related Problems
description: Pattern related to coping urges, craving management, or substance concerns.
safetyGuidance: This is not addiction treatment or medical advice. Do not use for obtaining, consuming, or combining substances. If in distress, contact professional support services.

solutions.title: Urge-Delay Timer
solutions.purpose: Provide a short pause during an immediate urge.
instructions: Urges are like ocean waves — they crest, peak, and inevitably fall.
Commit to sitting with this pause until the timer reaches zero.
Focus on your breathing and notice the urge intensity naturally shifting.
Sip water or change your physical location while waiting.

solutions.title: Controlled Breathing
instructions: Inhale deeply through your nose for 4 seconds.
Exhale slowly through your mouth for 6 seconds.
Focus entirely on physical sensation of breath entering and leaving.

solutions.title: Grounding Exercise
solutions.purpose: Redirect attention toward the present moment.
instructions: Press your feet firmly into the ground.
Hold a cool object or ice cube in your hand.
Focus on physical realities of this immediate second.

solutions.title: Trigger / Reflection Activity
solutions.purpose: Allow the user to reflect on what happened immediately before the current urge or difficult feeling.
instructions: Identify what emotion, event, or environment preceded this feeling.
Notice HALT signals: Am I Hungry, Angry, Lonely, or Tired?
Address the underlying physical or emotional need safely.

solutions.title: Support-Seeking Reminder
solutions.purpose: Encourage the user to contact a trusted person or professional support when appropriate.
